Title: These 7 principles make your emails more fun to read. (And put more cash on your bottom line.)
Body1_Heading: Your readers are skipping your emails too.
Body1_P1: You think that's just what AI copy is. It's not. That's lazy AI copy — intro three points conclusion every single time.
Body1_P2: Steal these 7 principles I use. Inject the fun. Get people who finish reading instead of secretly bailing.
Body2_P1: Busy bees buzzing about business. Cheesy on purpose. Still works.
Body2_P2: Your brain remembers how copy SOUNDS before what it says. Rewrite for beat — not grammar.
Body3_P1: Selling without a plan is like baking without a recipe. Messy. Disappointing. Smoke alarm going off.
Body3_P2: Don't explain harder. Translate. Hand them a picture and let their brain do the work.
Body4_P1: I'll tell you the weirdest trick I learned… but first a quick story.
Body4_P2: Your reader's brain hates unfinished business. That itch pulls them to the next line.
Body5_P1: Not a bad sales call. 37 cold calls. Everyone said no — except the guy eating a tuna sandwich.
Body5_P2: Vague sounds like AI. Specific sounds like a human was actually in the room.
Body6_P1: I'd rather wrestle a raccoon for the last slice of pizza than read another three-point AI email.
Body6_P2: Boring is the only unforgivable sin. One tiny chuckle buys you three more paragraphs.
Body7_P1: Write to one person. Short sentences. You and I — not dear valued customer.
Body7_P2: Call out their situation. Ask questions. Talk WITH them — that's how you get finished reads not secret skips.
Takeaway: STEAL THESE 7. LAZY AI COPY IS BORING. REAL AI COPY ISN'T.
